description: This file defines the HungarianMatcher class for computing assignment between network predictions and targets, including cost calculations and the matching algorithm, used in object detection models.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: A PyTorch module that computes an optimal assignment between predicted and target objects based on classification, bounding box, and GIoU costs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HungarianMatcher with specified cost weights.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the matching between predictions and targets, returning index pairs.
